question: The Matrice 4T ASRS report proves it lost its link and crashed. What should it have done according to the manual?

intake.reason: Question asks what manuals say about lost control link and the aircraft/pilot actions (return to home, hover, land, reconnect) for Matrice 4T

brief.short_answer: The DJI Matrice 4T incident report found in the collection does not describe a lost link, so it is not used as evidence. On loss of remote signal, if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, the manual requires the Failsafe RTH to engage automatically. It then starts RTH using Advanced RTH per the RTH settings. If vision/environment conditions are unsuitable, it will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH. If the RTH distance is over 50 m, it will orient and fly backward 50 m along the original route before Preset RTH.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states the preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures and the remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations.
claims.quote: Example (partial): The remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people. The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: AC 107-2A provides an example: try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
claims.quote: Example: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
conditions: attempt to reestablish the control link

claims.text: AC 107-2A Appendix A includes an example hazard: loss of control link over people.
claims.quote: Sample Safety Risk Assessment and Mitigation Steps Before Flight Risk Management – Example of Identified Potential Hazard Hazard Cause Effect Likelihood (1) Severity (2) Risk (3) Mitigation Emergency or Contingency Procedures (4) Describe “what might happen?” Example: Loss of control link over people Describe the “why might it happen?” Example: Loss of power supply from control station, small UAS out of range, signal interference from another device (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, etc.) Describe the effect.

claims.text: AC 107-2A Appendix A states Describe what will be done if the hazard occurs.
claims.quote: Describe what will be done if the hazard occurs.

claims.text: Loss of remote controller signal will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: If lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
conditions: Lighting and environment unsuitable for the vision system

claims.text: If the RTH distance is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.
claims.quote: If the RTH distance (the horizontal distance between the aircraft and the Home Point) is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.
